===== isolate only =====
block v30 slot Some(1): 18 ops, GND#p0#7 .. C#p0#1, travel 79.220 mm, plan 855dd7b790c2a03d
note: Set the work origin 5mm from the board in X and 5mm in Y — your 5mm / 5mm work clearance plus the room this job's cuts outside the board need. Nothing is machined nearer the zero than the clearance.
note: KiCad's stackup states no copper thickness for this face, so 0.035mm (1 oz) was assumed. The isolation depth is that plus the substrate penetration, and the channel width follows from it — set the stackup if the board is not 1 oz.
note: C and D are closer together than the narrowest cut this tool can make; nothing was cut between them and they are not isolated.
note: GND and SIG are closer together than the narrowest cut this tool can make; nothing was cut between them and they are not isolated.
note: Not isolated — closer together than the narrowest cut this bit can make, so no channel was cut between them and they stay joined: C / D, GND / SIG. Separate them by hand, or re-lay the board.

note: Removed 20 copper islands (8.09 mm²) and 4 thin strips of copper (1.04 mm²) the isolation pass had stranded. 1 more was left standing, the widest 0.76 mm across — too wide for the bit already in the spindle to be worth it.
